NewsArticle.Title: Client Screenshot
NewsArticle.Content: [Screenshot](http://www.darkages.com/2000/image/screen/client_990504.gif) and a synopsis of the features that are to be included in the commercial release of Dark Ages: What's new about the interface in this screenshot: - New health and mana display (purely graphical, yet more cool). - The box on the right will be for displaying a portrait of yourself or the person you click on. - Alternatively the box on the right will be for displaying an object that you click on. - Help button (same as pressing F1) - When you walk behind an object, you see yourself translucently. Other things being added for commercial release: - Original MP3s - Original sound effects (about 3 dozen sound effects for actions and spells)"
